messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Rtangle for knitr
parts:
Hi Lucia,

I believe 

knit("myscript.Rnw", tangle=TRUE)

will generate myscript.R with just the R code.  


On Thu, Jul 5, 2012 at 2:57 PM, LuciaLam <lucia...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all,
I might have just missed this somewhere, but is there a Rtangle function for knitr? It allows the extraction of just the R code from a .Rnw file.
Thanks in advance for any pointers!
Cheers,
Lucia
